Lookout Café, nestled within the prestigious Tanunda Pines Golf Club, is seeking a dedicated Full-Time Chef to join our growing team. We are a full-fledged restaurant offering a complete dine-in experience, with stunning panoramic views across the rolling vineyards and fairways of the Barossa Valley. Our venue combines relaxed café charm with restaurant-quality service, fresh seasonal menus, and the flexibility to host memorable events and parties.

Located just one hour from Adelaide in the heart of South Australia’s renowned Barossa Valley wine region, Lookout Café is more than a café — it is a destination restaurant perched high above the golf course. Guests enjoy indoor and outdoor dining with sweeping views that enhance every meal.
We serve breakfast, lunch, and all-day options featuring fresh, local produce. Our space is perfect for casual dining, group bookings, and special occasions. The venue’s function capabilities allow us to host parties, celebrations, corporate events, weddings, and private functions, making it a true hub for memorable gatherings in the Barossa.
As part of the Tanunda Pines Golf Club family, we welcome golfers, locals, tourists, and families daily in a welcoming, family-friendly environment. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional food, warm hospitality, and unforgettable views.


Task & responsibilities
Detailed Job Duties & Responsibilities as a Chef.

•	Menu Planning & Culinary Development:
Collaborate with management to design and refine a contemporary menu reflecting modern cuisine, incorporating seasonal produce, premium ingredients, and innovative culinary techniques.

Prepare and present high-quality dishes with precision, maintaining consistency in flavour, portioning, and presentation. Cater to diverse dietary requirements while upholding elevated dining standards.

Accommodation & Hospitality Manager

Pink Roadhouse – Oodnadatta, South Australia

The Pink Roadhouse is seeking an experienced Accommodation & Hospitality Manager to oversee the day-to-day operation of our remote hospitality, accommodation and tourism business in Oodnadatta, South Australia.

This is a senior, hands-on management position involving responsibility across accommodation, café, licensed liquor, retail, tourism and a co-located Australia Post Licensed Post Office. It is not an entry-level management, shift-supervisor or general front-of-house position.

The successful applicant must relocate to and reside in Oodnadatta on an ongoing basis. This is not a fly-in fly-out or drive-in drive-out position.

Key responsibilities
Manage the daily operation of the roadhouse, café, licensed bar and accommodation facilities
Supervise, roster, recruit, train and performance-manage staff
Oversee liquor licensing, RSA, food-safety and WHS compliance
Act as a Responsible Person for the licensed premises once approved
Manage accommodation bookings, housekeeping standards and guest services
Manage stock control, purchasing, supplier relationships, margins and operating costs
Oversee cash handling, reconciliations, reporting and administrative processes
Oversee the co-located Australia Post Licensed Post Office, including customer transactions, mail and parcel services, reconciliations and compliance procedures
Resolve staffing, customer and operational issues independently
Develop and implement operational procedures
Support business planning and continuous operational improvement
Build respectful working relationships with local residents, Aboriginal community members, contractors and tourists
Essential skills and experience

Applicants must demonstrate:

At least two years’ experience in a comparable hospitality or accommodation management position
Management responsibilities extending beyond shift supervision or general hospitality duties
Experience managing a multi-faceted operation involving accommodation, food service and licensed hospitality
Proven responsibility for staff rostering, recruitment, training, supervision and performance management
Experience with stock control, purchasing, supplier management and cost control
Experience managing cash reconciliations, operational reporting and compliance procedures
The ability to make independent operational and staffing decisions without daily on-site direction
A demonstrated understanding of the practical requirements and limitations of living and working in a remote community
Willingness and ability to relocate to and reside in Oodnadatta on an ongoing basis
Availability to work weekends and public holidays as required by the management roster
Current Responsible Service of Alcohol certification, or the ability to obtain it before commencing
Eligibility and willingness to obtain and maintain South Australian Responsible Person approval
Ability and willingness to complete all required Australia Post training, accreditation and compliance requirements
Ability to obtain a satisfactory National Police Check and satisfy the probity requirements associated with Australia Post services and liquor-licensing responsibilities
Highly desirable experience
Previous experience living and working in a remote or very remote location
Experience working respectfully with Aboriginal communities, customers and community organisations
Experience managing both accommodation and licensed hospitality operations
Experience in an outback tourism, roadhouse or remote-area business
Experience operating or supervising an Australia Post Licensed Post Office, postal agency or comparable regulated service
Experience handling secure transactions, customer information and strict procedural compliance
Experience using point-of-sale, accommodation-booking, rostering and financial-reporting systems
Current South Australian Responsible Person approval
Current Australian driver’s licence
Current first-aid certification
Employment details
Full-time, ongoing position
Salary: $90,000 per annum plus superannuation
Accommodation may be available under a separate arrangement
Location: Oodnadatta, South Australia
Weekend and public-holiday work will form part of the management roster

Employment will be subject to a satisfactory National Police Check and completion of the required Australia Post and liquor-licensing approval processes.

Application requirements

Applicants must submit:

A current résumé
A cover letter addressing the essential criteria
Specific examples demonstrating their management responsibilities
Details of the size and type of hospitality or accommodation operations they have managed
Details of their staff-management, financial and compliance responsibilities
Details of any remote-area, Australia Post or comparable regulated-service experience
Confirmation that they understand the location and are willing to relocate to and reside in Oodnadatta

Applications that do not include a cover letter addressing the essential criteria may not progress to the next stage.

Position: Retail Store Manager
Location: Gold Coast Pacific Fair – Pacific Fair Shopping Centre, 2–30 Hooker Boulevard, Broadbeach QLD 4218?
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time?
Hours: 38 hours per week?
Salary: AUD $85,000–$90,000 per annum, plus superannuation

This advertisement is posted by Comandini Migration Services on behalf of Golden Goose Australia Pty Ltd.

About Us
Golden Goose Australia Pty Ltd is a premium fashion retailer specialising in luxury sneakers, clothing, footwear, bags and accessories. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality products and exceptional customer service.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Retail Store Manager to lead our store operations, drive sales growth and deliver a world-class customer experience. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving commercial objectives, managing and developing the store team, maintaining brand and visual merchandising standards, and ensuring the efficient operation of the store.
This role requires a reliable, empowering and supportive leader with strong commercial awareness, excellent communication skills and proven experience managing a premium retail environment.

Key Responsibilities
Sales and Customer Experience
* Manage store sales targets and monitor performance through relevant key performance indicators.
* Develop and implement action plans in consultation with the Area Manager to improve sales performance.
* Lead and motivate the team to achieve commercial targets while maintaining high customer service standards.
* Ensure employees consistently follow the company’s selling processes, including up-selling, cross-selling and promoting available services.
* Provide customers with accurate information regarding products, pricing, services and expected timeframes.
* Build strong customer relationships through personalised service and regular follow-up.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement initiatives to improve customer satisfaction.
* Build relationships with the local community and act as a brand ambassador to attract new customers and retain existing clients.
* Manage customer database development, segmentation and profiling.
* Drive in-store and omnichannel sales by effectively using available systems, tools and technology.

Business and Network Development
* Support the Area Manager in developing long-term market growth strategies.
* Establish and maintain commercial relationships and partnerships within the local market.
* Monitor relevant retail and industry trends.
* Identify and recommend sales opportunities and business development initiatives.

Brand and Product Management
* Represent and promote the company’s brand values, heritage and vision.
* Ensure employees have a strong understanding of the brand, products and services.
* Monitor the store’s product assortment and provide feedback to Area Management and the Buying Team regarding customer and market demand.
* Oversee the overall presentation of the store.
* Maintain high visual merchandising and product display standards in accordance with company guidelines.
* Ensure the team remains informed and trained on all product collections and categories.
Team Leadership and Human Resources
* Recruit, manage, develop, motivate and empower store employees.
* Build a positive and supportive workplace culture based on trust, professionalism and accountability.
* Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, training and performance development.
* Conduct daily and weekly store briefings to communicate objectives, priorities and sales strategies.
* Support new employees throughout the onboarding process.
* Ensure employees comply with company grooming and uniform standards.
* Work closely with the Area Manager and Human Resources team to recruit suitable employees.
* Manage employee performance and implement appropriate improvement measures where required.
* Prepare staff rosters and ensure appropriate staffing levels are maintained.

Store Operations and Compliance
* Supervise and coordinate all store activities to ensure efficient daily operations.
* Ensure compliance with the company’s standard operating procedures.
* Oversee stock and back-of-house operations, including receiving and transferring stock, stocktaking, stock control, storage, reporting and store administration.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, governance requirements, privacy obligations, workplace health and safety requirements and other applicable regulations.
* Use relevant retail, customer relationship management and point-of-sale systems.
* Ensure employees are appropriately trained in all operational and digital systems.

Skills and Experience
The successful candidate will have:
* Relevant experience managing a retail store or comparable retail operation.
* Demonstrated experience leading, developing and motivating a retail team.
* Strong knowledge of retail sales, customer service and store operations.
* Proven ability to achieve sales targets and manage key performance indicators.
* Experience in stock management, visual merchandising and operational compliance.
* Strong commercial awareness and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, leadership and interpersonal skills.
* The ability to build strong relationships with customers, employees and business stakeholders.
* Experience using point-of-sale, customer relationship management and other retail management systems.
* The ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Experience in premium, luxury or fashion retail will be highly regarded.
